import sys

def main():
    reader = sys.stdin
    n = int(reader.readline().strip())
    input_str = reader.readline().strip()
    
    maximum = 0
    underscoreCount = 0
    last = -1
    flag = False
    
    for idx in range(len(input_str)):
        ch = input_str[idx]
        if ch == '_':
            if last != idx - 1:
                if flag:
                    underscoreCount += 1
                else:
                    maximum = max(maximum, idx - 1 - last)
            last = idx
        elif ch == '(':
            flag = True
            if last != idx - 1:
                maximum = max(maximum, idx - 1 - last)
            last = idx
        elif ch == ')':
            flag = False
            if last != idx - 1:
                underscoreCount += 1
            last = idx
    
    if last != len(input_str) - 1:
        maximum = max(maximum, len(input_str) - 1 - last)
    
    print(f"{maximum} {underscoreCount}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
